in_marathi.name: Nishad
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nishad हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nishad is derived from the Sanskrit word 'nishadha', which means 'abode' or 'residence'. In Hindu mythology, Nishad refers to a region or an island in the middle of a vast ocean. It is also the name of a sage in Hindu texts.
